_comment: Schema reference for client profiles in output/clients/{clientId}.json. All fields managed by lib/client-store.js

_example.name: Jane Speaker
_example.talkTitle: The Future of Women in Tech Leadership
_example.bio: Jane is a Fortune 500 executive who has helped 200+ organizations build diverse leadership pipelines. She speaks with rare specificity.
_example.notes: Reached out via 'stages' DM on 2026-06-03. Dave spoke with her 2026-06-10. Strong niche but fee needs work.

field_reference.name: string — full name
field_reference.dmSenderId: string | null — Meta sender ID from DM qualifier (links back to state.js)
field_reference.talkDurations: number[] — available lengths in minutes, e.g. [20, 45, 60]
field_reference.bio: string — short speaker bio for pitch emails
field_reference.topics: string[] — niche keywords, used to match conference topics

fee.min: number | null — minimum keynote fee in USD
fee.max: number | null — maximum keynote fee in USD

field_reference.qualScore: high | mid | low | null — score from DM qualifier
field_reference.updatedAt: ISO timestamp — auto-stamped on every save
